title: Best Bookstore SF: Eric Ries with Sarah Lacy — first Incorruptible launch event, anywhere
summary: Tech journalist Sarah Lacy (formerly TechCrunch, founder of Pando) hosts the first official Incorruptible launch event at Best Bookstore in Union Square, San Francisco — a week ahead of the May 26 release. $32 ticket includes a signed copy of the book.
blockquote: It is not hyperbole to call "the Lean Startup" the most important startup book in history (or one of them). @ericries new book "Incorruptible" will be the most important startup book of the next decade. And the first event will be at our store in downtown San Francisco.
